versions.changelog:
talking-head 2.0.0

- Bumped version to 2.0.0.
- Updated SKILL.md and metadata to reflect the new version.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.
- All text, usage instructions, and linked references remain unchanged except for versioning and file organization.

talking-head 1.1.1

- Version update to 1.1.1; metadata now reflects new version.
- Updated SKILL.md and CHANGELOG.md for clarity and accuracy.
- Removed deprecated file: skill-card.md.
- No functional/API changes to scenario, setup, or defaults.

talking-head 1.1.0

- Added first paid measurement of upstream delivery: default model (alibaba/wan-3.0-prime) now confirmed to speak at 3.16 words per second.
- Updated script budget advice: the 3 words per second planning rate now comes from direct measurement, not gallery prompts on unknown platforms.
- Clarified that the default model works end-to-end and the budget is slightly conservative.
- Improved documentation and accuracy across prompt planning and model behavior notes.
- Removed redundant documentation file (skill-card.md).

- Initial release of the talking-head skill.
- Generate a speaking-person video from a portrait plus a user-supplied script.
- Requires only text input; audio uploads are not supported or used.
- Defaults to the Alibaba/Wan 3.0 Prime model (not seedance-2.5) for better acceptance of real-person photos.
- Clearly describes input/output limitations, scenario fit, word/length budgeting, and model selection rationale.
